$comment: Bands, lead times and windows. Ministry-configurable: changing a threshold here is a data change, not a code change. Never render any of these numbers as a fixed figure in copy.

filingDeadline.$comment: Lead time BEFORE the event start. Level 1 is conditional per SPEC 8.1: filed before final event authorization is issued, and where no external authorization is required, at least this many days before. This is NOT the post-event report window, which is also 7 days but runs AFTER the event ends.

1.conditionEn: Filed before final event authorization is issued. Where no external authorization is required, at least 7 calendar days before the event.
1.conditionAr: يُقدَّم قبل صدور الترخيص النهائي للفعالية. وحيث لا يُشترط ترخيص خارجي، قبل 7 أيام تقويمية على الأقل من الفعالية.

postEventReport.$comment: A separate obligation from the filing deadline. Opens 00:00 Asia/Beirut the day after the event ENDS, not starts. Due within this many days of that opening.

seriousIncidentNotification.$comment: Distinct from the post-event report. Filing the report does not satisfy this.

types.en: Interruption or termination for medical reasons
types.ar: توقف الفعالية أو إنهاؤها لأسباب طبية
